title: Sanitize stderr warnings in closePrimaryShardOnMerge (close SEC-W-012-1)
description:
SEC-W-012-1 (carryover from TASK-012 security audit, status `still-leaks-deferred` through TASK-016): raw e.message stderr concatenations in scripts/merge-task.mjs closePrimaryShardOnMerge at L127/134/148/167/536/560 leak filesystem paths to stderr. Security-auditor flagged in TASK-016 review: should be closed BEFORE TASK-028 adds new error sites at the resolver, otherwise the leak class amplifies.

Fix: downgrade raw e.message stderr concatenations to opaque tokens (e.g., `[merge-task] WARN: shard close failed for TASK-NNN (reason: <REASON_CONST>)`) or gate full e.message behind a DEBUG_MERGE_TASK env var. Use task-id and reason constants only; no abs paths.

Apply the same sanitization pattern to closeLinkedShardsOnMerge and commitShardDeltas — the leak class affects all three sibling helpers. Coordinate with TASK-028 so both produce sanitized warnings.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/merge-task.mjs closePrimaryShardOnMerge stderr lines at L127/134/148/167/536/560 (current line numbers; track if shifted) no longer interpolate raw e.message
Same sanitization applied to closeLinkedShardsOnMerge and commitShardDeltas warning paths
DEBUG_MERGE_TASK=1 env var (or similar) restores full e.message for development debugging — opt-in only
Existing tests still pass (warning content tests must be updated to assert on sanitized format)
New unit test asserts that no warning emits an absolute path when DEBUG flag is unset
